fact: The ZNSDI article says 58 dataset layers (road network, power utility networks, Continuous Operation Reference System) have been published through the country's existing geoportal platform, and that a new national geoportal run by the SMART Zambia e-Government Division launched alongside the ZNSDI Policy; as_of is the document date, 2026-06-18.
The article says the geoportal integrates datasets from custodians such as the Zambia Electricity Supply Corporation and the Road Development Agency; as_of is the document date, 2026-06-18.

Zambia EITI says its online data portal for disclosing mining information and data went live at a Lusaka launch on 26 April 2024, attended by the Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development's permanent secretary.
ZamStats says most of its products are free and accessible through its website and data portal, and that it keeps an archive of data and publications on the portal.
